note: TBC1D32 variants cause Alsahan-Harris syndrome within the orofaciodigital ciliopathy spectrum, which characteristically features oral abnormalities like frenula and lingual hamartomas.

evidence.text: TBC1D32-related disorders are characterized within the orofaciodigital syndrome and ciliopathy spectrum, presenting with characteristic oral cavity, facial, and ciliary anomalies.

source.title: Diagnosis of TBC1D32‐associated conditions
source.quote: Oro-Facial-Digital (OFD) syndromes are defined by abnormalities of the face, oral cavity, and extremities.

evidence.text: Classical orofaciodigital presentation includes lingual hamartomas and accessory frenula, often overlapping with Joubert syndrome phenotypes.
